scope: Bounded next experiment for actual native level-8 Macedon Domination. Offline candidate lifecycle evidence does not prove native acceptance, resource receipt, upgrades, captures or win-rate gain.

baseline_native.result: Empty-payment two-Iron quote at ceiling34 was REJECTED; unmodified PROPOSED was REJECTED again. No cash purchase. This game retired152 without a rival original capital.

candidate_policy.arm: Only native Domination explicitly forced land-army-asks-the-host-price and not withheld
candidate_policy.behavior: After an exact affordable unpriced strategic cash quote, submit one one-time Gold offer up to the original ceiling, reduced for current cash/headroom/native item maximum. Preserve ask-time cash minus ceiling as a reserve. Retain existing host acceptance/equality/item checks; after an explicit bid refuse larger cash or future-income payment counters.
candidate_policy.paid_quote: Preserve an already-priced host quote rather than increasing it to the ceiling.
candidate_policy.stale_callbacks: An old rejected zero-payment callback cannot settle a priced offer; existing bounded closer can end the wait.
candidate_policy.tradeoff: A single ceiling bid prioritizes acquiring the material over finding the cheapest acceptable price. The AI-supplied cap and protected remaining cash are unchanged.
